WITH yearly_rev AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
  FROM olist.orders o
  JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2019, 2020)
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN revenue END))
  / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN revenue END), 0) * 100,
  1
) AS growth_rate
FROM yearly_rev
LIMIT 1

         ELSE (curr_rev - prev_rev) / prev_rev
       END AS growth
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_state = 'US' THEN 'US' ELSE 'International' END AS region,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2022 THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS curr_rev,
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2021 THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS prev_rev
  FROM olist.orders o
  JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN olist.sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  WHERE s.seller_id = 'JnJ'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2021-01-01'::timestamptz
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2023-01-01'::timestamptz
  GROUP BY region
) sub
LIMIT 1000
